testcase.name: epub rejects archive escape and ignores network resources()
large txt has multiple navigable sections with bounded text blocks()
epub follows spine order and preserves metadata text and local images()
entry resolution keeps plus signs decodes spaces and rejects remote or escaping paths()
long paragraphs are bounded without losing unicode or text()
zip renamed docx must contain the actual word document()
docx extracts body paragraphs line breaks tables and embedded images in order()
oversized section is rejected before it becomes a text view()
txt supports utf8 utf16 bom and windows1252()
bounded copy rejects overflow and pdf rendering has a bounded pixel budget()
